column1: # The value-gate corpus (ADR-0022): repositories at pinned commits. `fetch_corpus.sh` clones each,
# checks out the commit and verifies the checksum, so the task files under `tasks/` are reproducible.
# Columns (tab-separated): name, clone URL, commit, sha256 of `git ls-tree -r --full-tree HEAD`,
# tracked file count, languages (comma-separated basemind language names: rust, python, typescript, go,
# java; `gen_tasks.sh` emits each language's tasks and `gate.py` reports recall per language).
# basemind is pinned at v0.33.0, tokio at tokio-1.54.1, click (BSD-3-Clause) at 8.3.0, got (MIT) at v14.6.6,
# cobra (Apache-2.0) at v1.9.1, gson (Apache-2.0) at gson-parent-2.15.0 and restate-examples (MIT, a polyglot
# monorepo with eight `go.mod`, 29 `package.json` and five `pyproject.toml` roots) at v1.8.0.
